entityDescription:
CESEFOR (www.cesefor.com) is a private non-profit Foundation founded in January 2003. It is a Service provider for the promotion of forestry and forest-based industries, originally within the Region of Castile and León (one of the 17 Autonomous Regions in Spain) but today with a national and international remit. The Foundation contributes to the regional development, competitiveness and sustainability of the forestry industries that use regional forest resources. Cesefor signed in 2014 an agreement with the Regional Managing Authority for the development of a series of services and products related to the forestry sector (among these: conservation actions). The agreement covers a wide group of forestry fields. In order to do this, Cesefor brings together a range of services: capacity building, consultancy, training and R&D projects. 
Cesefor, as Forestry and Wood Technology Centre, has an extensive experience in the development of R&D&I projects, mainly focused on the enhancement of NWFP and the development of new wood products.
Another interesting and active working line for the project is focused on IT developments for the forestry sector: web and software development, GIS analysis and applications, mobile devices solutions for geographical projects, and high-tech solutions for forestry products evaluation, such as the Lidar application for forestry inventories.
CESEFOR is also present in several European Networks and highly experienced in communication and dissemination: graphic design, web page development and management, social media, event planning and organization, newsletters and media work. CESEFOR publishes “IndForma”: a leading e-newsletter of the Spanish forest sector. CESEFOR is an official member of the European Forest Institute; hosts the Secretariat of the Mediterranean Model Forest Network since 2008; it is member of the IUFRO Network and part of the Steering Committee of the ERIAFF Network and of the FAO SilvaMed’s CPMF.

Tailor Made ball valves out of special material in short delivery times

ATEC GmbH is located in Klein- Winternheim near Mainz and was established 1989 as a manufacturer of industrial ball valves.

We develop, design and manufacture special ball-valves for the chemical, pharmaceutical, food and cosmetic industries.

Our unique selling products are cavity free ball valves carried out in soft and metallic sealing systems manufactured out of
special materials like Titanium and Hastelloy ® for extreme conditions.

We attach great importance to manufacture all our ball valves in-house to be as flexible as possible towards our
customers and guarantee short delivery times.

By constantly changing requirements of our customers we have developed into a competent, innovative provider of
special ball valves for industrial use in many countries of the world.

Long experience of our qualified staff in the design, development and manufacturing guarantee for quality, reliability and flexibility.

Mission Statement
Our mission statement is to be the innovative, flexible partner for end-users and their suppliers within the process industry,
regarding specific demands, special circumstances, extraordinary applications, hard to obtain products and short delivery times for
ball valves in stainless steel, duplex, titanium and nickel alloys.

entityDescription:
know.space is a new specialist space economics consultancy. Founded by the leading space sector experts, Greg Sadlier and Will Lecky, it is motivated by a single mission: to be the source of authoritative economic knowledge for the space sector. 
We combine cutting-edge analysis with deep understanding of the space sector to deliver trusted knowledge to help you navigate hype, risk and uncertainty. 
We work with:
•	Public bodies to evaluate policy and value for money to maximise return on investment.
•	Space industry to make the case for funding, research markets, and demonstrate impact.
•	Applications & users to unlock powerful new insights from satellite + economic data.
•	Private investors to conduct commercial due diligence on space industry targets.
•	Academia to develop funding bids, and support analysis of space-related topics.
•	Non-space companies to help understand new opportunities enabled by satellite data.
Greg and Will are each highly-respected in their own right as experts in the economics and analysis of space, science and innovation. Together, they have more than 25 years of relevant experience, and offer a unique combination of:
•	knowledge of space investments, technology, industry and markets; and
•	knowledge of the space policy context and public sector funding decision-making.
Our services:
•	know. your market Bespoke advice and insight to help you navigate the complexities and uncertainties of rapidly changing space and satellite markets.
•	know. your investment Advice on where and how to apply for funding and help to develop your business case to give your project the best chance of success.
•	know. your impact Demonstrate value-for-money and maximise your return on investment by learning lessons from robust monitoring and evaluation.
•	know. your potential Unlock insights from data and strengthen your evidence and data analysis capabilities to ensure your decisions are grounded in compelling evidence.

Barrier Networks is a Scottish Cyber Security Company that specialises in protecting organisations from modern day cyber threats.
We partner with leading cyber security vendors and work in a trusted partner capacity to help our customers identify and resolve the cyber risks that threaten their business operations. As a ‘Trusted Partner’ of Police Scotland and the Scottish Business Resilience Centre we assist organisations with improving their cyber security and can accredit them with the National Cyber Security Centre’s Cyber Essentials and Cyber Essentials Plus certification. The NCSC recently chose IASME as the sole Partner for Cyber Essentials, of whom we are a Gold Partner and a GDPR certified assessment provider.
We work closely with Public Sector and Central Government and are a Scottish Government listed supplier for Digital Technology Services Dynamic Procurement System for Cyber Security, a UK Government G-Cloud Supplier and a UK Government Digital Outcomes Specialist supplier for Cyber Security.
Our Client base covers most industry verticals, but Finance and the sectors which rely on Industrial and Automated Control Systems are specialist delivery areas for us.
In addition to our cyber security activity we work closely with academia and help support our charity partner Erskine through fundraising.

INNO'Energy is a recent and dynamic company specializing in the following areas:
 • Research and Development (R & D) in satellite and physical oceanography, meteorology and climate : expertise, analysis and evaluation of data (in situ, satellite, models), numerical oceanic and meteorological modeling;
 • Marine and Onshore Renewable Energies: wind, solar, currents energy, wave energy, sea thermal energy.

INNO'Energy provides scientific expertise and engineering services in satellite data, in situ measurement and ocean and meteorological numerical models aimed at:
 • improving their quality,
 • increasing the knowledge of the modes of climate variability (regional and global oceanic and atmospheric circulation),
 • characterizing and qualifying the resource potential of renewable energies (marine and onshore) as well as assessing their predictability in the climate change context.

INNO'Energy also develops custom decision support software solutions tailored to the needs of:
 • analysis and assessments of satellite data and numerical models, 
 • climate variability studies, 
 • renewable energy (offshore and onshore) resource potential assessments,

entityDescription:
1 The STO Centre for Maritime Research and Experimentation (herein referred to as
CMRE) is an executive body of the STO and is governed by the provisions of the
STO Charter.
The CMRE is located in La Spezia, Italy.

2 Mission
2.1. Within the framework of the STO in-house delivery business model, the CMRE will
organise and conduct scientific research and technology development and deliver
innovative and field-tested S&T solutions to address the defence and security needs
of the Alliance.
2.2. Its mission will be centred on the maritime domain. It will sustain its core capabilities
in the maritime, and particularly the undersea, domain and, conformant with STB
policy guidance, may extrapolate into other domains to meet customers’ demands.
2.3. It will be financed through customer funding. Customers will be comprised of NATO
bodies, NATO Nations and other parties, consistent with NATO policy.
2.4. In its areas of expertise, the CMRE will also provide advisory support to the STB, its
chairperson, the Chief Scientist and his/her Office.

entityDescription:
Montimage is a French SME located in the central 13th district of Paris. It is a research oriented company that proposes its know-how and tools for monitoring and testing network traffic and services. The tools are dedicated to help developers and operators improve the quality and reliability of their services.
Montimage relies on innovation to deliver competitive tools and know-how that provide end-to-end monitoring solutions integrating functional, QoS and security analysis of network communications and business activity. For this Montimage has developed an integrated modular set of tools that makes it possible to perform traffic inspection and activity monitoring based on formal models and machine learning used to identify the expected behaviour and anomalies. The tool framework is called MMT (Montimage Monitoring Tool) and can be deployed as a stand-alone tool for operators, a library that can be integrated in specialised frameworks or applications, or as a cloud service. These tools are applied to different domains (including: Telecommunications, eHealth and Industry 4.0...) and environments (IoT, SCADA, Critical Infrastructures, Cyber Physical Systems, 4G/5G...). 
The core business of Montimage is developing tools for monitoring and testing networks, applications and services; in particular, for the analysis of functional, performance and security aspects; and, for improving context awareness and end-user trust. Montimage's flagship tool (MMT) allows the capture of telecommunication packets, as well as any structured messages, for performing traffic analysis, estimating quality of user experience (QoE), analysing security and detecting/mitigating security attacks. It uses deep packet inspection (DPI), statistics and machine learning techniques to classify traffic and analyse its behaviour.
Montimage has participated in the development of the ground system data processing and visulaisation for the Plank space mission, in the development of cybersecurity solutions for Thales and the French department of Defense, and is very active in European collaborative research projects in the domain of future mobile networks, cyber physical systems, critical infrastructures, Iot networks, advanced testing and monitoring techniques, etc.

Montimage has participated in the development of the ground system data processing and visulaisation for the Plank space mission, in the development of cybersecurity solutions for Thales and the French department of Defense, and is very active in European collaborative research projects in the domain of future mobile networks, cyber physical systems, critical infrastructures, Iot networks, advanced testing and monitoring techniques, etc.

entityName: State Nature Conservancy of Slovak Republic
entityDescription: The State Nature Conservancy of the Slovak Republic (SNC) is a government/public institution operating on the basis of the state/government budget contribution and own income, however, it is not primarily a profit making institution. It was established by the Ministry of the Environment of the Slovak Republic. SNC SR is an expert institution focused on actions for nature and landscape conservation and administration of Slovak caves accessible to visitors in accordance with the provisions of the Act. No. 543/2002 C.L. on Nature and Landscape Conservation as amended by later regulations. Its actions are also governed by the Act No. 15/2005 C.L. on the Conservation of Wild Animals and Plants through Regulating Trade therein. Scope of activities of the SNC SR covers the following: area protection, species (both animals and plants) protection, protection of minerals and fossils, protection of woody vegetation on not-forest land, environmental education, training and promotion, monitoring a relevant information systems. Specific activities relevant to aforementioned fields of actions include: development of draft strategies, concepts, programmes and formulating/designing nature conservation measure, methodologies, development of background documents for law making activities, formulating of technical standpoints and background documents for decision-making activities, development of projects for new designations or amendments of protected areas, research and monitoring of protected areas and species, management of publicly accessible caves, information centres, educational trails and sites, international co-operation in the field of nature/biodiversity conservation, publishing. SNC SR coordinates technical implementation of NATURA 2000 network in Slovakia. It is a designated scientific authority for the purpose of CITES and coordinates actions in Slovak biosphere reserves designated under the UNESCO-MAB Programme. SNC SR has a long term experiences with implementing the projects, including international ones. All projects at which SNC SR have participated or has been participating/implementing are focused on nature and biodiversity conservation, particularly on area and species protection, through implementing management measures in protected areas, as well as on education, training and communication in this area. SNC SR implemented several projects funded through various financial schemes/programmes.

entityDescription: Vingineers uses remote sensing data in order to provide vineyards with precise analysis of vine health and growth data in order to manage and improve vine heath, harvest timing, and vineyard sustainability. Vingineers focuses on combining drone and satellite remote sensing data to provide analytics based upon machine learning and deep neural networks. The resulting modeling of the vineyard fields helps winemakers to better predict their harvest timing, flavor profiles, fertilization planning, and disease control. Vingineers also integrates local sensor data from the fields with satellite based weather data to predict and model overall growth cycles and determine the best practices to improve wine quality and value.
